The '''Crimson Kreehawks''' was a gang of criminals and disenfranchised youth that was based on the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jorra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. Their activities ranged from dealing [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to extortion, and they were loyal to the [[Whitescar Syndicate]].
